estimand: Conditional same-state differences among no-pseudo, plain aggregate, scalar-guard and joint-guard outcomes on one fixed TRAIN audit measure
observation_unit: One supervised-reference state and one frozen candidate/audit tuple; sampled crops within a patient are dependent

identity: full Git commit plus exact source_digest file scope and artifact digests
parameter names, device, dtype, library/CUDA versions
labeled patient allowlist and total annotation budget
pre_state: hashes and retrievable snapshots or exact replay dependencies for student parameters/buffers, optimizer states, teacher and RNG streams before supervised step
supervised-step outcome theta_s hash and supervised loss/gradient/clipping/update counters
teacher snapshot used for this transaction; state phase explicitly declared
data_and_measure: TRAIN-only supervised/audit/U patient IDs, frame/slice IDs, crop/padding/augmentation metadata, input and label artifact hashes
separate supervised and audit patient identity check
per-audit-slice/per-class positive/negative counts and weights; absent-positive flags
audit reduction order and effective normalization/mass for every group
shadow TRAIN support identities if used, fixed before outcomes and prohibited from policy selection
fixed_candidates: teacher q artifact or exact regeneration dependency; teacher hash and forward count
accepted pseudo mask, common accepted denominator, class pixel counts
unique source IDs and ordering, parameter block, pseudo step size
candidate direction artifacts or exact deterministic regeneration dependencies
direction norms, nonzero counts, effective dtype and source multiplicity
local_problem: A_c,b_c,e_c for every group in original declared units
ridge lambda, risk budgets, feasibility and optimality tolerances
scalar restricted ridge m*lambda and scalar solution
joint candidate solution, numerical status, baseline-subtracted objective and group changes
independent feasibility and incumbent comparison; no implication of global optimality from a success flag
actual_trial_outcomes: for each no-pseudo/plain/scalar/joint option: alpha, scale, actual effective parameter displacement and changed-element count
every attempted finite-trial scale, not just the accepted trial
before/after per-group actual Brier; finiteness; exact acceptance and mean-risk tests
risk recomputation witness: either frozen audit labels/weights/probabilities or exact weighted sum_w_y2,sum_w_yp,sum_w_p2 sufficient statistics per group
explicit category for no candidate, verified local zero, numerical failure, no representable displacement, finite rejection and effective acceptance
commit: declared trajectory-driving policy and chosen option
pre/post parameter-buffer hashes, actual committed-risk check
optimizer state unchanged by pseudo transaction; no hidden optimizer transformation
rejected and shadow trials leave live state unchanged
one EMA update only after final live commit; post-EMA hash and counter
timing and memory split among candidate gradients, JVPs, solve, finite trials and checkpoint work

decision_recomputation.risk: R_c=0.5*(sum_w_y2-2*sum_w_yp+sum_w_p2), using the frozen declared group weights
decision_recomputation.guard_accepts: All actual outputs finite; for every group R_trial<=R_reference+budget+tolerance; mean R_trial<=mean R_reference+tolerance; apply source-exact handling of zero directions/scales
decision_recomputation.portfolio_order: If a future selector chooses minimum observed mean actual risk among the same finite feasible options including fallback, the selected observed mean cannot exceed the included options' observed mean; no population or Dice implication
decision_recomputation.scope: These scalar/statistic records suffice to recompute the declared decision only conditional on their truthful generation; independent model replay additionally requires the referenced state/input/direction bytes or validated deterministic regeneration

policy_effect_requires_separate_evidence: Fresh independently evolving policy arms from matched initial state and data schedule; later teacher/candidates may differ as mediated policy outcomes
Frozen final evaluation on prospectively specified patients, class/frame support and metric denominator policy
Repeated subset/init blocks and measured compute for any practical utility claim
No VAL/TEST labels used to create coefficients, select trial candidates, tune thresholds or choose patients
No current-audit risk ordering promoted to external-patient safety or repairability
